title: ArduPlane SITL dies at startup with a saved parameter set
platform: ArduPilot ArduPlane, SITL (software-in-the-loop) build on a desktop, started with a particular saved parameter/EEPROM file
symptom: ArduPlane SITL dies during startup, before any dataflash log is written, every time it is started with a certain saved parameter set; the reporter attached the gdb output of the crash.
provenance: Log copied from the public issue thread (machine output posted by the reporter). Not synthetic. Used in sealed evaluation batch 1, so it is no longer a blind test case.
